# Generic example: compress all subdirectories of parent_dir into .zip files and delete them
access_token = get_file_system_token(apis, main_user)  # e.g., via login
subdirs = apis.file_system.show_directory(
    directory_path=parent_dir,
    access_token=access_token,
    recursive=False
)
for path in subdirs:
    name = path.rstrip('/').split('/')[-1]
    apis.file_system.compress_directory(
        directory_path=path,
        compressed_file_path=f"{parent_dir}/{name}.zip",
        access_token=access_token,
        delete_directory=True,
        overwrite=True
    )
apis.supervisor.complete_task(status='success', answer=None)
